result.reason: The added covenant includes all preferred coverages and limits: CGL at USD 1M/2M, E&O at USD 2M, cyber/privacy at USD 5M while processing Licensee data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It leaves the unrelated representation-by-counsel provision unchanged. However, requiring every policy to remain in place for one year after the term goes beyond the supplied playbook and is not necessary to reach the preferred position. The drafting is otherwise professional, though the post-termination requirement could conflict with the cyber coverage qualifier if data processing has ceased.
